A small fix release. All three issues were found while recording the demo and writing the [blog post](https://blackman99.github.io/linelore/docs/blog/git-blame-says-who-not-why/) on psf/requests.

## Fixed
- **Review comments are no longer passed off as being about your line.** If no review comment is within 6 lines of the blamed line, linelore still shows the file's closest comments, but now labels them `elsewhere in this file, line N at review time`, or `elsewhere in this file, outdated diff` when GitHub gives no line. Comments that are near keep the plain `(line N)` label. `--json` adds `"near": true|false` to each review comment.
- **`--offline` says what it did.** The note now reads `offline: showing local commit only` instead of the misleading `no GitHub remote`.
- **`--rev` works after files move.** `linelore requests/adapters.py:258 --rev v2.31.0` used to crash with a `FileNotFoundError` traceback when that directory no longer existed in the working tree. It now blames the file at that revision.

## Install
```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore@v0.1.1
# or
pip install https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore/releases/download/v0.1.1/linelore-0.1.1-py3-none-any.whl
```

Python 3.9+, no dependencies. Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.md)
